ips.description: List of 1 to 1000 IP addresses. Managed execution accepts only distinct bare IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, with one lookup charged per entry. BYOK also supports URL patterns. For free tier tokens, prefix IPs with 'lite/' (e.g., 'lite/8.8.8.8'). Supports field extraction patterns like 'lite/8.8.8.8/country' or 'lite/8.8.8.8/asn'. IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are both supported.

filter.description: When True, entries with null responses are omitted from results. Useful for filtering out invalid IPs.
